name_reason: Follows the DPMI wrapper naming convention fd2_dpmi_<descriptor>; 'free_dos_memory' precisely describes DPMI INT 31h fn 0x101 (Free DOS Memory Block). No Ghidra address residue in the name. No domain ID involved.
purpose: DPMI INT 31h function 0x101 (Free DOS Memory Block) wrapper: releases a DOS conventional memory block by its protected-mode selector handle.
logic_summary: Builds a union REGS request with eax=0x101 and edx=selector&0xFFFF (DX register slot), then calls int386(0x31, &in_r, &out_r). Output registers / carry flag are discarded; void return. The first two declared params are placeholder remnants of the 3-output alloc API surface and are never read (disassembly confirms only [ESP+0x44]=arg3 is loaded into the edx slot at REGS offset 0xC).
signature: void fd2_dpmi_free_dos_memory(uint32 linear_unused, uint32 segment_unused, uint32 selector)

params.name: linear_unused
params.semantics: Unused placeholder for parameter symmetry with fd2_dpmi_alloc_dos_memory's linear-address output; never read by the body (callers pass driver->linear at +8).
params.reason: Name accurately marks the parameter as an unused placeholder; no address residue, no misleading generic param_N.

params.name: segment_unused
params.semantics: Unused placeholder for symmetry with the real-mode segment output of alloc; never read (callers pass driver->segment at +0).
params.reason: Name accurately marks the parameter as an unused placeholder; no address residue, no misleading generic param_N.

params.name: selector
params.semantics: Protected-mode selector handle of the DOS memory block to free; low 16 bits placed into the DX register slot for DPMI fn 0x101 (callers pass driver->selector at +4).
params.reason: Name precisely reflects the DPMI selector handle that is the sole operative input; no address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; DPMI carry/result registers are discarded.

notes: Source comment block (src/util/dpmi.c lines 57-65) is already accurate and concise: documents fn 0x101, the 3-param symmetry rationale, and that only the selector is used, citing [ESP+0x44] -> DX slot. Verified by disassembly (SUB ESP,0x38; MOV [ESP],0x101; MOV EAX,[ESP+0x44]; AND EAX,0xffff; MOV [ESP+0xc],EAX; int386(0x31,...)) and by caller AIL_internal_uninstall_driver_inner @ 0x3f840, which calls fd2_dpmi_free_dos_memory(driver+8, driver+0, driver+4) -- confirming arg3 (selector) is the only operative input. Ghidra plate is more verbose but semantically consistent with the source, so left untouched. No src edit needed (comment=keep).
